name: Ishidate Takeru
source:
An archery club member with a has a strong body and manly appearance who has a surprisingly indecisive and timid personality.
Rather than being on good terms with [url=/c16016]Shirakawa Kazui[/url], Takeru prefers to just follow him around.

[Translated from [url=http://web.archive.org/web/20050407195831/http://zui.co.jp/products/kashoku/kashoku.html]official website[/url].]
